video_metadata.title: My Trading Strategy is Boring (But it Works)

input.transcript_snippet: So the strategy I'm going to walk you through is actually pretty simple once you understand the core concepts. Step one is always higher timeframe bias. Weekly. Daily. Four hour. All three need to be trending in the same direction. Then what I'm looking for is a swing failure pattern. Price raids an old swing high or low. The wick goes through, closes back through. That's the trap signal. Step three is the displacement and the fair value gap. A large body candle creates a fair value gap, breaks market structure. Enter inside the FVG. Stop below the raided swing. Minimum 2R or skip the trade. Best targets are equal highs and equal lows.

entry_sequence.name: htf_bias_confirmed
entry_sequence.rule: weekly + daily + 4H all trending in same direction; higher highs + higher lows for long bias OR lower highs + lower lows for short bias

entry_sequence.name: liquidity_raid_sfp
entry_sequence.rule: price raids prior swing high or low (wick through), then CLOSES BACK through that level — the wick takes retail out then the closure is the trap signal

entry_sequence.name: displacement_with_fvg_entry
entry_sequence.rule: large body candle creates fair value gap AND breaks market structure; enter inside the FVG

stop_loss_structured.rationale: below the swing low that was raided — the SFP invalidation point

targets.rationale: speaker says 'best targets are equal highs and equal lows'

filters.rationale: speaker says minimum 2R or skip the trade
